name: Sideshow
label: 10K
lede: Born in Tigray, raised in the DMV, based in LA: a deadpan rapper who spent six years on short, murky tapes, then dropped 32 tracks across four discs and got an 8.4 from Pitchfork.

eras.title: Three tapes and a war
eras.text: Sideshow arrives in 2020 with three projects, all listed on 10K, built on a rotating cast of underground beatmakers and guests from the same drumless, jazz-flecked rap scene as MIKE, MAVI and Earl Sweatshirt. In November, war breaks out in the Tigray region where he was born.

years.h: Farley: a first mixtape stacked with underground guests
years.p: Guest verses from MIKE, [[MAVI|175a1b69-7a19-4881-b1ca-fe6b84ff3a2d]], Na-Kel Smith, Medhane and ZelooperZ; [[Alexander Spit|e100d317-f6e9-4f2b-9002-e13087e02f87]] is one of the producers.
years.xp:
Album of the Year lists Farley as a February 24, 2020 mixtape with production from Budgie, Kahlil Blu, Sid Roams, supersportlo and Alexander Spit, among others.

Wikipedia's Alexander Spit page dates the tape to 2013, which does not match any other source; the page uses 2020.

years.h: Asked Amlak to Wash My Hands arrives five weeks later
years.p: Produced by [[Alexander Spit|e100d317-f6e9-4f2b-9002-e13087e02f87]] and CoffeeBlack. The Ginger Shot EP is also dated 2020.

years.src: Wikipedia: Tigray war · BLAC D.C.: Artist of the Week Sideshow
years.h: The Tigray War begins, and Sideshow talks about it in public
years.p: Ethiopian federal forces, allied with Eritrea, go to war with the TPLF. A 2022 BLAC D.C. profile calls him a vocal advocate for Tigrayans on social media.
years.xp:
Wikipedia dates the war from November 3, 2020 to a cessation of hostilities agreement signed November 2, 2022.

BLAC D.C. also describes a multi-hyphenate: rapper, model, graphic and fashion designer, with campaigns for Carhartt, Converse and Snobs Downtown, and a clothing line called Unknown Assailant.

eras.title: Deadpan in a drumless room
eras.text: Two releases, one leap. Wicked Man's Reprise gets the guests and the Alexander Spit beats; WEGAHTA TAPES VOL. 1 gets Pitchfork's attention.

years.src: AOTY: Wicked Man's Reprise · Fresh Music Freaks: Sideshow Unveils New Album
years.h: Wicked Man's Reprise: jazzy loops, guest spots from MAVI and Na-Kel Smith
years.p: [[Alexander Spit|e100d317-f6e9-4f2b-9002-e13087e02f87]] produces several tracks, joined by Black Noi$e, Bori and CoffeeBlack.
years.xp:
Fresh Music Freaks lists [[Navy Blue|304c731f-ea4f-407c-b4fc-65131b1b2b37]] among the guests, alongside MAVI and Na-Kel Smith.

Album of the Year users file it under drumless, jazz-rap and East Coast hip-hop.

q: a vivid panorama of his existence with each deadpan bar
years.src: AOTY: WEGAHTA TAPES VOL. 1 · BLAC D.C.: Artist of the Week Sideshow
years.h: WEGAHTA TAPES VOL. 1: ten tracks, sixteen minutes, one Pitchfork review
years.p: Features from MIKE and [[MAVI|175a1b69-7a19-4881-b1ca-fe6b84ff3a2d]]. Pitchfork's Dylan Green hears a rapper burrowing deeper into a subdued sound.
years.xp:
Album of the Year dates the mixtape to May 13, 2022; BLAC D.C.'s June 6 profile describes it as out that week, so the exact day is loose.

The same profile says he had toured the previous year on Small World Big Love with MIKE and Osun, with sold-out shows from Richmond to New York, and that he splits his time between LA and the DC area.

eras.title: Faster, meaner, more of it
eras.text: He puts out an LP, an EP and an album in sixteen months, the grimier end of the same underground, with Alexander Spit still around and El Cousteau turning up as a co-writer.

years.h: 2MM DON'T JUST STAND THERE!: a Valee guest verse on the title track
years.p: Producers include [[Alexander Spit|e100d317-f6e9-4f2b-9002-e13087e02f87]], Popstar Benny, AYOCHILLMANNN and Omari Lyseight. HipHopDX's Mackenzie Cummings-Grady scored it 82.
years.xp: Cummings-Grady wrote that the cloudy loops had become more claustrophobic, but that Sideshow sometimes used the dense backdrops to sneak in some optimism.

years.h: JAM: seven tracks, twelve minutes, all Alexander Spit
years.p: A joint EP with the LA producer; El Cousteau appears on one track.

years.src: AOTY: F.U.N. T.O.Y. · Hip-Hop Wired: Sideshow Defiantly Highlights
years.h: F.U.N. T.O.Y.: 17 tracks, T-Pain and Still UA on the credits
years.p: Pitchfork's Dash Lewis scored it 7.6 and called the crackling production what gave it its energy.
years.xp:
Bandcamp credits JWLES, T-Pain, MAY DAY, El Cousteau and Still UA as features. Producers include Popstar Benny, Rorzhak, Alexander Spit, EazyT. and Blase. Hip-Hop Wired later named it among its best projects of 2024.

Lewis's line: grimier and druggier than ever. The same critic would review TIGRAY FUNK two years later.

eras.title: Thirty-two tracks for Tigray
eras.text: After two years of recording, the biggest release of his career and the biggest room he has played: Europe with Earl Sweatshirt, then a Best New Music tag from Pitchfork.

years.src: V13: Sideshow Announces February 27th Release · The FADER: Sideshow announces new album TIGRAY FUNK · Hip-Hop Wired: Sideshow Defiantly Highlights
years.h: Sideshow opens for Earl Sweatshirt across Europe
years.p: The European leg of the 3L World Tour ran January 20 to February 6, with the album still five weeks from release.
years.xp: V13 and The FADER both note the run; The FADER says the album came out of two years of recording. Earl Sweatshirt, as randomblackdude, is credited with producing on the album per Hip-Hop Wired.

years.src: The FADER: Sideshow announces new album TIGRAY FUNK · BrooklynVegan: Sideshow announces new album
yt: LIFES AS VIOLENT AS YOU MAKE IT
years.h: "LIFES AS VIOLENT AS YOU MAKE IT": first single, produced by Alexander Spit
years.p: Juan Nieto directs the video; the album is announced for February 27 on 10K.

years.src: Good Stuff Only: Sideshow's constant chaos · The FADER: Sideshow announces new album TIGRAY FUNK · In Search of Media: sideshow tigray funk · BrooklynVegan: Sideshow announces new album · Hip-Hop Wired: Sideshow Defiantly Highlights
years.p: Producers include Tony Seltzer, Laron, Anysia Kym, Popstar Benny and Surf Gang's harrison; guests are [[Niontay|f82718b9-abf9-4dc1-8c0e-eea218c2b973]], [[El Cousteau|2ee5a7a9-9bcb-4d72-8cc9-845549f45dfb]], Kelow Latesha and SEXWORKS.
years.xp:
Good Stuff Only calls it possibly the first four-disc rap album. The FADER says it grapples with the Tigray War's personal cost and with being a Black man in America, and Brooklyn Vegan notes a parable running through it.

In Search of Media's reviewer points to the ethio-jazz feel of "ALENA (ኣለና) PARADISE LOST." Hip-Hop Wired notes that he rarely does press.

q: a dazed survey of personal highs and lows
years.src: AOTY: TIGRAY FUNK · Kurrco on X
years.h: Pitchfork gives TIGRAY FUNK an 8.4 and Best New Music
years.p: Dash Lewis: the Tigray-born, DMV-raised rapper's flow rides roughshod over his producers' strangest beats.
years.xp: The score and the tag show up in AOTY's critic table and in a Kurrco post dated March 4, 2026. AOTY users rated it 76 out of 100.

years.src: The FADER: Sideshow disses JPEGMAFIA · Wikipedia: Pompeii // Utility
years.h: "EXPERIMENTAL RAP (BLACK CROSS+)" takes aim at JPEGMAFIA
years.p: Dylvinci produces the reply, prompted by JPEGMAFIA's remarks on Earl Sweatshirt and MIKE's Pompeii // Utility.
years.xp: The FADER reports that JPEGMAFIA called the Earl and MIKE double album not experimental enough and that Earl answered with memes on Instagram. Pompeii // Utility, made entirely with Surf Gang production, is dated April 3, 2026.

years.h: Sold-out Pearl Street Warehouse, Washington, DC
years.p: Opened by El Rocco and Falamoun; Union Stage's listing bills him as a rapper from Addis Ababa raised in the DMV.
